objectives.description: Fake ps recognizing -C lake,lean emitting synthetic 5-row tree, plus same rows on the plain -eo invocation
Fixture /proc/<pid>/status files via PROC_ROOT for the synthetic PIDs
Dry-run-clean assertion: lists all 5 PIDs + total, fake-kill log empty
Fake kill (via enable -n kill, since kill is a bash builtin) logging signal+pid
ORDERING assertion: workers before server before root, via log sequence
Claude pass's own --dry-run unaffected by Lean rows in its snapshot
Extend mutation-check marker list with new function/fixture names

approaches_tried.approach: Override kill via plain PATH=fakebin:... env var (mirroring the fake-ps pattern)
approaches_tried.reason: kill is a bash builtin, not an external command -- PATH override is silently ignored by bash's command lookup, which resolves builtins before consulting PATH; all synthetic PIDs came back 'already gone' since the real kill -0 saw genuinely nonexistent PIDs

deviations.description: Add a fake ps on PATH ... while delegating every other ps invocation to the real ps resolved to an absolute path before PATH is overridden -- the same ancestry-safe technique assertion (d-2) already uses.
deviations.reason: This fixture's fake ps answers every invocation shape itself (-p self-check, -C lake,lean, and the plain -eo table) rather than delegating non-matching calls to the real ps; the ancestry-walk self-pid trick from (d-2) is not needed here since no row in this fixture needs to distinguish the running test script's own pid -- all 5 rows are synthetic Lean-tree PIDs unrelated to $$.
